scope.summary: W4 external-client cases for the dictionary tools (list_schemas, schema_inspect, describe, describe_index, describe_trigger, describe_view, sample_rows, read_clob, plscope_inspect; scripts/e2e/w4/cases/dictionary-tools.json, 41 cases) green over stdio and Streamable HTTP on FREE 23ai, XE 21 and XE 18, with per-case isolated fixtures (df03922d rework) so expectations hold both alone and in the family.
out_of_scope: ADB behaviour and unlisted behaviours, per the bead's no-claim.
oraclemcp-euxm0 (read_clob LOB alias vs column-name masking rules; masked today via mask_unknown_default).
